stage_cards.purpose: Freeze source pack, PlanUnit index, project context, and policy hashes before compile work starts.
algorithm: Compare source, plan, project, test, and policy hashes to the approved snapshot.
Block stale inputs or write a bounded reanalysis route before any stage work.
Persist compile cursor, last_green_hashes, and resume action.

stage_cards.purpose: Select the exact PlanUnits and acceptance units participating in the compile.
algorithm: Filter active accepted PlanUnits by source pack authority and dependency reachability.
Record explicit exclusions and why they are safe.
Reject scopes with unresolved owner or dependency ambiguity.
parallelism: controller may split by owner doc

stage_cards.purpose: Normalize source PlanUnits into implementation-facing compile rows.
algorithm: Expand acceptance criteria and source_lineage for each PlanUnit.
Classify GUI/frontend/backend/testing/source-control metadata.
Reject rows with fake acceptance, stub-like filler text, or missing source evidence.
exit_gates: every row has acceptance and source evidence
parallelism: mandatory owner-doc parallel review for broad scopes

stage_cards.purpose: Discover repository, harness, capability, and source-control facts before work shaping.
algorithm: Probe project-native runners and available visual/headed surfaces.
Resolve Git, non-Git, remote, and greenfield path authority through the snapshot variant.
Record blocked or missing capabilities without marking them passed.

stage_cards.purpose: Classify dependencies by owner, validation, build, runtime, and serialization meaning.
algorithm: Map owner_reference and consumer_reference edges separately from executable ordering.
Constrain build_dependency and runtime_prerequisite edges before WorkGraph drafting.
Block dependency cycles that affect executable ordering.
exit_gates: typed graph acyclic for executable edges
parallelism: parallel graph review for large scopes

stage_cards.purpose: Map each unit to bounded read/write/implementation surfaces.
algorithm: Separate canonical owner surfaces, consumer surfaces, test surfaces, and generated artifacts.
Detect write conflicts and serialization requirements.
Reject requests with unbounded or unsupported write surfaces.

stage_cards.purpose: Classify work type, effort, risk, authority, model, context, and capability lanes.
algorithm: Assign risk, reasoning, model, capability, and authority fields from owner metadata.
Require user-visible and authority risk to be explicit.
Block unknown capability requirements before request drafting.

stage_cards.purpose: Draft non-executable NodeSeed candidates with complete source and test metadata.
algorithm: Create candidates with source PlanUnits, acceptance units, objectives, surfaces, tests, dependencies, and blockers.
Keep candidates generated intermediate proposals, not runtime nodes.
Reject candidates with empty acceptance or validator lists.

stage_cards.purpose: Ensure candidates are independently sized and safely ordered.
algorithm: Split overlarge candidates along ownership, write-set, or test-boundary lines.
Merge tiny dependent candidates only when write conflicts and validation remain bounded.
Record sizing rationale and ordering impact.
parallelism: parallel sizing review for broad scopes

stage_cards.purpose: Independently review NodeSeed candidates before graph construction.
algorithm: Launch reviewer roles separate from candidate drafters.
Require findings, approvals, or required changes for every candidate.
Reject graph construction if mandatory review receipts are absent.

stage_cards.purpose: Construct the reviewable WorkGraph draft from approved candidates.
algorithm: Build graph nodes only from approved candidates.
Set entrypoints from dependency roots and verify every entrypoint is a graph node.
Validate scheduler policy, authority, evidence, and graph integrity.

stage_cards.purpose: Convert graph nodes into canonical WorkNodeRequest records for Executor intake.
algorithm: Populate every direct WorkNodeRequest field from the canonical handoff schema.
Bind test, model, capability, source-control, authority, cancellation, and evidence requirements.
Reject requests with empty objectives, acceptance, validators, surfaces, or source PlanUnits.
exit_gates: request count equals graph node count
parallelism: parallel request construction by graph partition

stage_cards.purpose: Audit compile artifacts and repair bounded defects before certification.
algorithm: Run structure, schema, source-lineage, test-binding, authority, and zero-incomplete checks.
Create closure rows for every actionable finding.
Re-audit repaired artifacts until certified or blocked.

stage_cards.purpose: Certify Executor intake readiness without starting runtime work prematurely.
algorithm: Submit graph/request bundle to structural intake checks.
Require all required active-scope requests accepted together.
Do not silently launch a partial build when mixed acceptance occurs.
exit_gates: executor intake accepted or blocked with evidence
parallelism: Executor structural intake plus controller verification

stage_cards.purpose: Atomically bind GoalRun, WorkGraph, WorkNodeRecords, entrypoints, and BuildStarted outbox.
algorithm: Create or bind one GoalRun for the accepted graph and idempotency key.
Materialize WorkNodeRecords one-to-one from accepted WorkNodeRequests.
Queue entrypoints and write start event through a transactional outbox.

stage_cards.purpose: Project launch state into Orchestrator without duplicating PlanCompileRun or GoalRun identity.
algorithm: Navigate to Plan Compile immediately after approval with a bound run or launch handle.
Bind pending projection identity to the existing PlanCompileRun when outbox projection catches up.
Expose Open Build only after activation commit and durable start receipt.
exit_gates: projection identity reconciled without duplicate runs
